title: Fonctions L / Équation fonctionnelle des fonctions L (cas géométrique) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. f: X -> S is compactifiable: f = f̄ ∘ i, with i: X -> X̄ an open immersion and f̄: X̄ -> S proper. Let Y = X̄ - X be the closed complement, with closed immersion j: Y -> X̄. F is a torsion (étale or ℓ-adic) sheaf on X.

Step 1. The basic triangle on X̄ is i_!F -> Ri_*F -> j_*j^*Ri_*F -> (+1). The page writes the third term as (Ri_*F)|Y and draws the 'flèche de retour' for the connecting map.

Step 2. Apply Rf̄_*. Since f̄ is proper, Rf̄_* i_! = Rf_!. Also Rf̄_* Ri_* = Rf_*. This gives the long exact sequence
... -> R^i f_!F -> R^i f_*F -> R^i_∞ f(F) -> R^{i+1} f_!F -> ...
where R^i_∞ f(F) := R^i f̄_*((Ri_*F)|Y), the 'cohomology at infinity' (boundary cohomology, cohomology of the 'link at infinity').

Step 3. Alternative description. Apply the localization triangle j_*Rj^!K -> K -> Ri_*i^*K to K = i_!F. Since i^*i_!F = F, this gives j_*Rj^!(i_!F) -> i_!F -> Ri_*F. Comparing with Step 1 identifies j^*Ri_*F ≅ Rj^!(i_!F)[1]. The page says '(Ri_*F)|Y est donné par Rj^! Ri_!(F)'; the shift is omitted.

Purpose. In a folder on the functional equation of L-functions (geometric case), this is the comparison between L-functions with and without compact support. The 'defect' is a contribution from infinity, R_∞f. For curves this is the sum over the punctures of the local terms (inertia invariants and coinvariants of F), i.e. local factors at infinity.

Archive note. The neighbouring pages are typed Bourbaki drafts (Algèbre commutative ch. VII, n° 392), so this sheet is probably a manuscript note on scrap paper.
errors: The identification omits the degree shift. Correctly, j^*Ri_*F ≅ Rj^!(i_!F)[1], not Rj^!(i_!F).
The page does not address whether R_∞ f is independent of the chosen compactification. It is, via standard arguments as in SGA 4 XVII, but this is not shown here.
The notation is loose. (Ri_*F)|Y means j^*Ri_*F, and R^i f̄_* of it really means R^i(f̄∘j)_*. Writing Rj^!(Ri_!F) is harmless since i_! is exact.

ideas.what: Long exact sequence relating compactly supported, ordinary and 'at infinity' higher direct images, via a compactification
ideas.modern_name: boundary cohomology / cohomology at infinity; localization triangle i_! -> Ri_* -> j_*j^*Ri_*
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck-Artin-Verdier (SGA 4, six operations); 'boundary cohomology' terminology later, e.g. Harder, Pink for Shimura varieties
ideas.where_published: The triangle formalism is in SGA 4 (Exp. XVII by Deligne for Rf_!). The explicit R_∞ notation possibly appears in SGA 5 material on L-functions; unsure.

ideas.what: Identification of the boundary restriction j^*Ri_*F with j^!i_!F[1]

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine application of the localization triangle to define cohomology at infinity, which is standard in the six-functor formalism. Its only interest is as a working note toward local terms at infinity in the functional equation of L-functions.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: the trailing '.....' after 'Cohomologie à l'infini :' is just dots in the image, not missing text.
In the first triangle the middle term reads ℝi_*(F) (possibly first written as something else and overwritten); it is not a separate '[?]' arrow.

'On peut aussi considérer la suite exacte de cohomologie [?]' should read roughly '...la suite exacte de cohomologie à support relative à ℝi_!(F) sur X̄, et l'ouvert X et Y = X̄ − X, fermé associé :'.
Last lines: 'et on déduit d'une autre façon' is more likely 'et on déduit d'une autre façon que' / 'd'une manière précise'; the final statement is '(Ri_*F)|Y est donné par Rj^! Ri_!(F)'.
